title: An operator-valued map on R^n is C^m iff all its columns are C^m
statement: Let n, m be natural numbers, E a real normed space, R^n = EuclideanSpace R (Fin n), U any subset of R^n, and g : R^n -> L(R^n, E) a map into the continuous linear maps from R^n to E. Let e_k = EuclideanSpace.single k 1 for k in Fin n be the standard basis vectors. Then g is C^m on U if and only if, for every k in Fin n, the column map x -> g(x) e_k is C^m on U.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (m : ℕ) (g : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] E)) (U : Set (Rn n)), ContDiffOn ℝ m g U ↔ ∀ k : Fin n, ContDiffOn ℝ m (fun x => g x (EuclideanSpace.single k (1 : ℝ))) U
